'''Sarasia''' is a [[Kin]]swoman.

== Appearance ==
She is plump, with a grandmotherly air.

== Activities ==
Sarasia, with the assistance of three other Kinswomen, creates a [[gateway]] into [[Cairhien]] for [[Elayne Trakand]] to go to coronation.
